title: Q&A with AI researchers Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo on the odds of an intelligence explosion before 2029, pausing AI, the US antagonizing China, and more (Dwarkesh Patel/Dwarkesh Podcast)
summary: Dwarkesh Patel / Dwarkesh Podcast: Q&A with AI researchers Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo on the odds of an intelligence explosion before 2029, pausing AI, the US antagonizing China, and more — “If we pause now, people still won't understand what's at stake.” — New podcast episode between Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo.
